C1.worst_defect: The hero gives four buttons of near-equal weight ('Live demo', 'Quick start', 'Try with your store', 'GitHub'). 'Try with your store' is never explained in the hero, and there is no picture of the till anywhere on the page, so a POS product's first screen is text only. On phone the buttons wrap as 2+2 rows of unequal widths, centred raggedly.

C2.worst_defect: Minimum plugin versions disagree: Troubleshooting's header-notice list says 'Run plugin 0.1.0 or later', while the quick start pins 0.3.0 and needs the plugin to 'advertise order.create v4 and register v1', and the Changelog says v5 arrived in 0.3.0.
C2.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01 'Act on a header notice' bullet 5; quick-start.desktop.04 'Missing / old plugin'

C3.worst_defect: Step 8 'Sign in and make a sale', the step that produces the working till, is two dense prose paragraphs (store URL, credentials, channel token, barcode field, float, tender, print, sync check, offline test). It is not a numbered list, so the order of actions on the sign-in screen has to be dug out of running text. Step 3 also asks you to write and run two TypeScript entry files without naming a command.

C4.worst_defect: 'At the till' documents a UI only through bold button labels ('Cash in the drawer to start', 'Parked (n)', 'Card payment approved', 'Paid in / out') and has no screenshot, so a reader cannot match the prose to the screen. Device-key setup is also repeated almost word for word in quick-start step 4 and in Connect a till.
C4.where: at-the-till.desktop.01 (whole page); quick-start.desktop.02 step 4 vs connect-a-till.desktop.01

C5.worst_defect: The home page body is a wall of ten identical grey bordered cards (5 rows x 2, same weight, no icon or visual), then a plain table, with no product screenshot to break the rhythm. In the docs, inline code breaks mid-token across lines ('tally-' / 'pos' in Overview and quick-start step 8, 'connect-' / 'src'). Plugin setup's 'migrations: [...]' block is cut off at the right edge even at 1440 px ('TallyPos\').
C5.where: home.desktop.01 cards (y~540-1215); docs.desktop.01 (y~460-490); quick-start.desktop.03 (y~1338); plugin-setup.desktop.01 code block (y~1234)

C6.worst_defect: In quick-start step 6 at 390 px, the tax-strategy table cuts off its answer column: 'taxOptions.orderTaxCalc', 'new OrderLevelTaxCalcul', 'DefaultOrderTaxCalculati' are clipped at the screen edge with nothing showing the table scrolls. The left column crushes '(pricesIncludeTax: false)' onto three lines with a lone parenthesis. Every code block also clips mid-line, even the one-liner "tokenMethod: ['bearer', 'cookie', 'api-key']", and on home the comparison table's first column wraps 'Open and close a register with a Z report' onto four lines.
C6.where: quick-start.phone.05 bottom - quick-start.phone.06 top; quick-start.phone.02-03 code blocks; home.phone.03 table

C7.worst_defect: The share card uses a pink and purple palette (dashed rule, ring logo, bottom bar) that appears nowhere on the monochrome site. Its 'logo' is an empty circle, and the body text repeats the headline ('Point of sale for Vendure' / 'Open-source point of sale for Vendure'). The 404 page reuses the home meta description.

overall_worst.defect: On a phone, the quick start's step 6 tax table, the one place that says which orderTaxCalculationStrategy to use, is clipped at the right edge ('new OrderLevelTaxCalcul', 'DefaultOrderTaxCalculati') with no sign that it scrolls. Its left column crushes '(pricesIncludeTax: false)' onto three lines.
overall_worst.fix: Replace the two-row table with two labelled lines or short code blocks ('Tax-exclusive → new OrderLevelTaxCalculationStrategy()', 'Tax-inclusive → new DefaultOrderTaxCalculationStrategy()'), or stack the table into label/value rows below 640 px so nothing is clipped.
